communications.subject: Arkansas Freedom of Information Act Request: RR-KMR3-XVC6
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arkansas Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

November 11, 2026

Custodian of Records
UAMS Medical Center

Re: Public Records Request under your state's public records law [RR-KMR3-XVC6]

Dear Custodian of Records:

Under your state's public records law, I request copies of the following public records:

Records Sought
For the period January 1, 2019 to the date of this request, I request the two items below.

Vendors: “Beckman Coulter” and any leasing or financing company that holds the equipment agreement for a system named in item 1.

Please search these vendor names in your contract database, and also search the offices that keep these records outside it: the Clinical Laboratory, Purchasing, and Accounts Payable. If no responsive record exists for an item, please state that in writing for that item.

1. Analyzer and laboratory-automation agreements
Executed agreements, however titled (reagent rental, cost-per-reportable-result, cost-per-test, purchase, lease, rental, placement, loan, or evaluation agreements, including any group purchasing organization member agreement signed with the vendor), for the DxC, the AU, the DxI, or the Access 2 analyzers, and for any product supplied with them (for example: DxA 5000, Power Express, AutoMate 2500, or Remisol Advance). These agreements should be provided together with all amendments, exhibits, addenda, and pricing schedules.

2. Reagent pricing, purchase commitments, and rebates
Executed agreements, however titled (product, pricing, rebate, or commitment agreements), for the DxC, AU, DxI, and Access reagents used on the systems in item 1, including each price exhibit or test menu that states a price per test or per reportable result, a commitment tier, or an annual purchase or volume commitment. Along with these agreements, include (a) any shortfall invoice, true-up or reconciliation statement, credit memo, or rebate statement issued by the vendor under them; and (b) records of any analyzer, automation, software, service, or reagent the vendor provided at no charge.

The records in 2(a) and 2(b) are requested in addition to, not in place of, the agreements. If any pricing term is withheld as exempt, please release the remainder of the agreement with only that term redacted, and cite the exemption applied.

Please provide an estimate of any fees before processing this request and notify me before incurring costs. I agree to pay reasonable and customary fees for processing this request.

Please respond within the time required by law.

If you deny this request in whole or in part, please cite each specific exemption you believe justifies withholding and inform me of the applicable appeal procedures.

Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Joe Meyerson

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Joe Meyerson
